reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its observable purpose is to explain market structure, price levels, and possible trading scenarios for BTC, ETH, SOL, and NEAR through chart-based analysis. The speaker presents possible long and short trades as conditional, speculative plans and acknowledges that a trade may lose. The Chart Champions membership is presented as trading education, with a disclaimer that the information is educational and future results are not guaranteed.

citations.quote: In this video, I want to clarify my exact thoughts on the local, but also the higher timeframe price action on BTC.
With your membership, you’ll get: 🎯 Full educational video library covering technical analysis, market structure, and trading psychology
I know that my plans won't play out every single time
everything I'm doing as always is no financial advice
I did buy Ethereum down here. Yes, as it was a predefined level.

opening.argument: Judge, the participation path is more concrete than the educational framing suggests. The speaker says he bought Solana and identifies a lower price as an even better opportunity; for NEAR, he describes building a long trade. The description then invites viewers to register for a trading membership. Taken together, the video presents potential gains from crypto positions alongside a route for viewers to engage further with the trading service. The opportunity language gives that registration pitch its force, even though no return is guaranteed.

citations.quote: I did buy Solana spot. However if we take the lows once more and move into $58 on Solana, I have an even better opportunity
So I am interested in building my first long trade here.
Start your journey today → https://portal.chartchampions.com/auth/register?selectedPlan=champion&selectedTerm=1

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's market-analysis quote identifies the subject, not the full purpose. Its membership-library quote also confirms that viewers are being offered a membership. Acknowledging possible losses and saying the material is not financial advice do not erase the combination of described purchase opportunities and a registration invitation.

citations.quote: With your membership, you’ll get: 🎯 Full educational video library covering technical analysis, market structure, and trading psychology
I did buy Solana spot. However if we take the lows once more and move into $58 on Solana, I have an even better opportunity

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited registration is for an education membership, not a route to purchase SOL or NEAR. The speaker makes the proposed trades conditional on price action and explicitly allows for a losing trade. Linking separate analysis and membership passages does not establish a deceptive token-purchase offer.

opening.argument: Several signals deserve attention in combination. The description advertises a community of 40,000+ traders and directs viewers to join. In the video, the speaker says he would take a BTC long trade at a specified level after a bullish reaction, then describes NEAR as a speculative position he is willing to risk money on. That mix of social proof, a registration link, and specific crypto entry ideas can encourage viewers to treat an uncertain market call as an opportunity they should participate in. The risk warnings are real, but they sit beside the invitation and the trade examples.

citations.quote: Join 40,000+ traders now → https://chartchampions.com?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=long&utm_campaign=tradingpplan
if we hit this level and we see a positive, so a bullish reaction, I will 100% take this long trade
I am willing to risk just a little bit to find out if that trade is going to work or not

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to a trading plan, a possible loss, and a disclaimer. Those qualify the pitch but do not address its social-proof invitation or the speaker's emphatic statement about taking a trade. Nor does saying he bought Ethereum at a predefined level make the presented opportunities merely abstract.

citations.quote: Join 40,000+ traders now
I will 100% take this long trade
I did buy Ethereum down here. Yes, as it was a predefined level.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A community-size claim, link, and discussion of crypto trades are not by themselves evidence of deception. The BTC statement requires both reaching a level and seeing a bullish reaction. The speaker also calls NEAR risky and says it could go to zero. Those are material qualifications, not a claim of easy appreciation.

citations.quote: if we hit this level and we see a positive, so a bullish reaction, I will 100% take this long trade
It is a risky play.
if this does not play out, this has a super good chance to go to 0

opening.argument: The chart lesson also functions as a promotional demonstration. The speaker refers viewers to earlier public videos and live streams for an Ethereum level, describes member-requested altcoin updates, and offers a NEAR long-trade setup. The description turns that ongoing analysis into a membership offer with live market updates and live trading sessions. A judge should therefore consider the trade discussion and the service promotion together: the former demonstrates the kind of actionable opportunities the latter offers access to, rather than existing solely as detached financial news.

citations.quote: I gave that on a live stream. I gave that in public videos.

And this setup simply looks at a retracement long trade.
With your membership, you’ll get: 🎯 Full educational video library covering technical analysis, market structure, and trading psychology 📊 Daily live market update streams with professional traders

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense accurately identifies chart analysis, but that does not settle whether the analysis also promotes participation. Its own membership citation establishes a commercial offer. The speaker's references to live streams and member-requested updates connect the featured trade ideas to that continuing service; a disclaimer does not make that connection disappear.

citations.quote: With your membership, you’ll get: 🎯 Full educational video library covering technical analysis, market structure, and trading psychology
I do altcoin weekly updates people can request alt coins that they want

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The service promotion is disclosed, and its stated offering is education, updates, and live trading sessions. The video also gives substantive, conditional analysis without requiring membership or a token purchase. For NEAR specifically, the speaker says the idea is speculative and that he is prepared for it to fail. Promotion of trading education does not establish a deceptive investment solicitation.
